sloka: तत्तस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा वाल्मीकिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।शत्रुघ्न शृणु यस्येदं बभूवायतनं पुरा ।। ७.६५.९ ॥
transliteration: tattasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā vālmīkirvākyamabravīt ।śatrughna śṛṇu yasyedaṁ babhūvāyatanaṁ purā ।। 7.65.9 ॥

translations.english: Having heard his words, Valmiki spoke, saying, "O Shatrughna, listen to whose abode this place formerly was."
